XMLDB.COMMENT: Parent accounts: the parent<->child links, keyed on the parent's phone number so a link can exist before the parent account does.

TABLE.NAME: local_parent_link
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per parent-child relationship. The join key is the normalized parent phone, so a student can name a parent who has not signed up yet (parentid null, status pending); the parent's own sign-up fills parentid and flips the row to linked.

FIELD.NAME: parentphone
FIELD.COMMENT: Normalized parent phone (E.164-ish, digits only with country code) — the join key.

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: The parent (a Moodle user id); NULL while the link is still pending (no parent account yet).

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending (no parent account yet) | linked (parent account exists and role assigned) | rejected.

FIELD.NAME: verified
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the parent phone was verified (e.g. OTP) before the link was trusted. Reserved for the verification step.

INDEX.NAME: phonestudent_uix
INDEX.COMMENT: One link row per (parent phone, student) — a student naming the same number twice is not two links.
